title: Workspace pattern: resizable primary region, yielding panels, compact rail
summary: Add a workspace pattern: a primary region that stays primary and can be resized by the person, side panels that yield (shrink, drawer, stack) before it, choices stored as preferences rather than measurements, and a compact icon rail for the application sidebar. Candidate principles P23 to P26 and candidate presets preset.workspace and preset.app-sidebar-rail travel as files in this folder; docs/WORKSPACE_PATTERN.md and the reference code (src/ui/workspaceGeometry.ts, src/ui/workspace.tsx, route #/workspace) are outside guidance/ and change no approved rule. It generalizes: any app with an image, canvas, preview, map or board as its main region hits the same layout problems. Open for the owner: ghost buttons (FB-0018) are deliberately not decided; whether the four size buttons are too many controls (P10); whether P26 needs a check; the CHK-011 collector matches every aside; the default size keeps panels at preferred width so it can be small on mid-size windows.

negative.description: Fixed-size central content: a 640px board or preview box. Too small on a large monitor, too large on a laptop, and the person cannot change it.
Storing a measurement as a preference: the window shrinks, the clamped size is saved, and the person's choice is lost for good.
negative.snippet:
const shown = Math.min(Math.max(size, 280), maxThatFits);
localStorage.setItem('size', String(shown));  /* P25: stores the clamp, not the choice */

negative.description: Panels that squeeze the primary region and vanish with no way back: a fixed 360px column on each side at every width, hidden by display:none on small screens.
negative.snippet: @media (max-width: 1000px) { .side { display: none; } }  /* P24: deleted, not yielded */

positive.description: Reference route #/workspace at 1440px: primary preview centered, panels docked at equal reserve, size controls and a corner slider handle.
At 1100px the panels shrink and the application sidebar is the 56px rail; the preview keeps its usable size (P23, P24).
At 390px the workspace stacks: the preview first at full width, panels below as sections, 40px touch targets (P24, P18).
Geometry is a pure function and the stored size is only an input.
positive.snippet:
const g = computeWorkspace({ width, height, padding: 16, gap: 16, chromeY, left, right, leftOpen, rightOpen, preferred: prefs.size /* null = responsive default */ });
prefs.setSize(pickedSize); /* the pick, never g.size */

validation.notes: Run by claude-agent: no new failing checks on the 12 approved references at 1440 and 390; tap test 940 tested, 0 undersized, 0 mismatches. Not an approval. The desktop layout comparison reports 'changed' for trading only (57 elements at 1440 in this run). The same comparison reported trading changed (82 and 82) on the untouched repository before any change in this proposal, and two consecutive recordings of trading differ run to run (the simulated terminal is time dependent), so it is a pre-existing flake in scripts/layout-snapshot.mjs and not caused by this change; the other 11 apps show 0 changed elements. The candidate adds no check, so no check outcome can change. #/workspace itself: run-checks reports no findings at 1440x900 and 390x844 and test-tap-targets reports 35 tested, 0 undersized.

existingApplications.note: Existing applications are not changed. The 12 prototypes render identically (npm run test:desktop-layout). CaissaTrainer keeps guidance 0.1.0 in its summa-ui.usage.json until the owner approves a release and requests an update. AppShell gained an optional compact prop that is off by default.
